answer.says: Ramesh, put the plate here. I will eat and then rest a little before the heat of the afternoon sets in. The file is with Mr. Saxena for another fifteen days, so there is nothing to do but wait and think.
answer.thought: The food is simple but the heat is already rising in the room. I have spent the morning wrestling with the idea of the state and the reality of this bureaucracy, which seems to operate by a different logic than my philosophy. I will eat, rest, and then perhaps walk to the Directorate to see if the wind has changed, though I expect it to be as stagnant as the air in the office.
